card.line: Mount Seir is a hill country given by God to Esau's family, the Edomites, and it is a place where Israel wandered, God won a battle, and judgment was announced.

moments.title: Israel wanders near Seir
moments.text: Israel wandered around Mount Seir for many days. Then the LORD told them to turn north and not to provoke Esau's descendants, because He had given Mount Seir to Esau.

moments.title: Simeonites settle on Mount Seir
moments.text: Five hundred Simeonites went to Mount Seir and struck down the Amalekites who had escaped. They lived there from then on.

moments.title: God defeats the invading armies
moments.text: As Judah's people sang praises, the LORD set ambushes against the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, and they were defeated. Judah found only bodies on the ground.

moments.title: God speaks against Mount Seir
moments.text: The LORD told Ezekiel to prophesy against Mount Seir. He said He would make it a desolate waste because of its ancient hatred of Israel.
